paragraphs.text: David thought that if Uriah lay with his wife, his sin might be covered.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: By this God would touch David's conscience, for seeing the fidelity and religion of his servant, he would declare himself forgetful of God, and injurious to his servant.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: He made him drink more liberally than he was wont to do, thinking by this he would have slept with his wife.

paragraphs.text: Except God continually uphold us with his mighty Spirit, the most perfect fall headlong into all vice and abomination.

paragraphs.text: He conceals the truth from the messenger, so that neither his cruel commandment, nor Joab's wicked obedience would be discovered.
